objects.name: Analytic 2266
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies Windows host-based firewall or network policy changes that selectively block Industrial Control System (ICS) communication traffic types from Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA)/Distributed Control System (DCS) hosts. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: WinEventLog:Security
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Windows Security Windows Filtering Platform / Firewall audit events (policy-dependent): firewall rule change selectively blocking one Industrial Control Systems (ICS) traffic type from Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA)/Distributed Control System (DCS) host without corresponding change ticket
